action: Extreme macro. A brass winding key seated in a back plate. It turns - once, twice, three times. On the fourth turn the ratchet slips and the key overshoots with no bite.
character_state: off-frame; only her back plate and the key are visible
character_position: back plate filling frame, key at centre
prop_state: key: engaged, slipping on the fourth turn
camera_intention: Locked-off macro, ~100mm, razor-thin depth of field. No movement at all. The audience does not yet know what it is looking at.
sound: Three dry ratchet clicks, close and intimate. Distant wind under. No music.
continuity_notes: First appearance of the key and back plate. The fourth-turn slip is the film's inciting incident and must read clearly at any size.

action: Macro on the glass chest drum. Inside, the coil tightens - then a single spring tooth shears off, pings against the glass and falls out of frame. The needle swings upward, hesitates, sags, and settles on 92.
character_state: coil under load, one tooth lost
character_position: chest drum filling frame
prop_state: spring: one tooth sheared, permanently degraded. Gauge: settles at 92.
camera_intention: Macro with a very slight push-in. The number 92 must be legible and centred.
sound: A bright metallic ping on the shear, then a low sub thud as the needle settles. Silence under.
continuity_notes: 92 is established here at 00:08, inside the eight-second hook deadline. This exact needle position is the reference for every later gauge shot.
transition_out: Cut to a held static on the gauge.

action: Hold on the gauge. 92. The needle trembles once and is still. Out of focus, warm amber lamp light drifts across the glass.
character_position: chest drum, static
prop_state: gauge: 92, steady
camera_intention: Static macro. The only true stillness in the opening - it lets the number land.
sound: Wind. Distant water. Nothing else. The silence is the point.
continuity_notes: The amber defocus is the harbour lamp, established before we see it. Do not identify the source yet.

action: Slow pull back and up. The frame opens out to reveal WICK - forty centimetres of aged brass - alone on a barnacled stone quay. Behind her, a drowned harbour town. One lamp still burns on a post. Dusk.
character_state: powered, upright, unaware she is being watched
character_position: centre of the quay, small in a wide frame
prop_state: gauge: 92. Lamp-pole lying on the stone beside her.
camera_intention: Slow crane back and up, macro to wide. This is the reveal; the move must be unhurried and continuous so the scale change reads as a single thought.
sound: Harbour ambience swells in as we widen: water, wind through iron, no birds.
continuity_notes: First full view of WICK and of the world. The single burning lamp must be in frame and clearly the only light source.

action: WICK's shutter eyes open - the apertures irising up from black. She looks down at her own chest gauge, and holds on what it says.
character_position: centre of the quay, three-quarter to camera
prop_state: gauge: 92. Key still seated in her back, now useless.
camera_intention: Low, at her eye height, with a slight handheld micro-drift. The aperture opening is the whole event of the shot.
sound: Her clock motif, first statement: three thin notes on a single instrument. Wind.
continuity_notes: The shutter-eye open is her first expression and sets the vocabulary for the whole film. Aperture range established here is reused for every later emotional beat.
transition_out: Cut to her point of view.

action: Her point of view: the dark, unlit beacon tower on the horizon across black water. Hold. She does not move.
character_position: off-frame; this is what she is looking at
prop_state: tower: dark, beacon cold. Water between.
camera_intention: Her POV, slightly wide, static. Deliberately unglamorous - the tower must read as far away and unlit.
sound: Wind. The clock motif does not resolve; it simply stops.
continuity_notes: First view of the tower from her perspective. Bearing and water line must match SC02_SH004, which shoots it from the opposite side.

action: WICK at the winding pillar, a brass column at the centre of the plaza. She backs up to it and raises herself onto the socket - a practised, habitual, daily motion.
character_position: at the base of the pillar, back to the socket
prop_state: pillar: intact but about to be shown stripped. Key: in her back.
camera_intention: Medium low. The pillar looms above her. Composition puts her small against the thing that normally sustains her.
sound: Her joints. The small click of alignment as she seats herself.
continuity_notes: The pillar is the same asset seen in the SC01 wide. Her approach must read as habitual, not exploratory.
transition_out: Cut to macro on the socket.

action: Macro on the socket: stripped, the teeth worn away. The key enters and spins free with no bite. She withdraws and tries again. And again.
character_position: at the pillar
prop_state: socket: stripped, unusable for the rest of the film. Key: still in her back, now the only key there is.
camera_intention: Macro on the socket, then a fast cut-in on her shutter apertures closing - her one available expression of alarm.
sound: Three hollow spins with no ratchet underneath. On the third, absolute silence.
continuity_notes: The stripped socket is permanent. No later scene may imply the pillar can be repaired.

action: Wide over the harbour to the horizon. A single amber running light, low on the water, moving toward the reef line.
character_state: off-frame; this is what she is looking at
character_position: n/a
prop_state: ship: distant, one running light, closing on the reef
camera_intention: Long lens, 200mm equivalent. The light is tiny in frame and the reef line is a darker band below it. Hold.
sound: Wind. A distant bell buoy, slow and irregular. First statement of the ship's motif: two descending notes.
continuity_notes: The ship is never seen closer than this until SC09. Reef line position must match SC09_SH002 exactly.

action: Reverse, from the waterline: the beacon tower, black against a bruised sky, unlit.
character_position: n/a
prop_state: tower: dark, beacon cold
camera_intention: Wide angle from the waterline, the tower leaning away from us. Its height should feel slightly wrong, slightly unclimbable.
sound: Wind rising. Iron groaning under load.
continuity_notes: This is the first view of the tower's full height. The plating and handholds seen here are the same ones climbed in SC07.

action: Close on WICK's chest. The gauge reads 92. The dark tower is reflected in her shutter lenses.
character_position: at the pillar, turned toward the tower
prop_state: gauge: 92, unmoved
camera_intention: Close, with the gauge filling the lower third. The tower reflection in her lenses does the eyeline work.
sound: Her clock motif, second statement - noticeably faster than the first.
continuity_notes: The three-point eyeline is ship / tower / own chest. This shot is the third point and must contain the tower reflection to complete it.

action: She reaches down and lifts the lamp-pole from the stone. It is taller than she is. She sets it against her shoulder, takes one step toward the tower.
character_position: leaving the pillar, moving frame left
prop_state: lamp-pole: picked up, carried on her shoulder
camera_intention: Low profile, static. She walks out of frame left. Cut on the footfall, not after it.
sound: The pole scraping stone. One footfall. Then the score's first forward motion underneath.
continuity_notes: The pole leaves with her here and is not lost until SC05_SH003. Its length relative to her body must stay consistent.

action: Lateral tracking. WICK crosses the plaza. With every stride the gauge ticks down: 92, 90, 88.
character_position: traversing the quay, frame right to left
prop_state: gauge: 92 to 88. Lamp-pole on her shoulder.
camera_intention: Lateral dolly at her height, holding the gauge in frame throughout. This shot teaches the audience to watch the gauge.
sound: Ratchet ticks locked to her footfalls. This is the film's central sound idea and it starts here.
continuity_notes: The tick-to-footfall sync must be exact - it is the grammar the rest of the film relies on. Gauge decrements in even steps.

action: Insert on the gauge. 88 to 86. The needle moves in discrete, audible steps rather than smoothly.
character_position: n/a
prop_state: gauge: 88 to 86
camera_intention: Macro insert, dead static. Framed identically to SC01_SH003 so the audience reads it as the same instrument.
sound: Two ticks, loud and dry, with nothing under them.
continuity_notes: Gauge insert framing is now locked: same lens, same angle, same lighting key for every insert in the film.

action: Wide. The drowned harbour in full: barnacled arches, kelp swaying in the shallows, rooftops under black water. Beautiful, and completely empty.
character_position: lower third, moving away from camera
prop_state: gauge: 86 to 85 (not visible)
camera_intention: High crane, slow push. The only genuinely calm image in the film - the camera must not hurry.
sound: The music opens out: strings, warm, the only major-key passage in the film.
continuity_notes: This is the beauty pass. It exists so the audience has something to lose. Kelp and water motion must be gentle here and violent from SC05.

action: She passes a row of harbour lamp posts, all dead. She does not stop. Behind her, the one lamp that still burns.
character_position: moving through the row, frame left
prop_state: gauge: 85 to 84. Dead lamps; one burning lamp behind.
camera_intention: Medium tracking, the foreground poles strobing past and repeatedly breaking the frame.
sound: The clock motif continues under the strings. Wind.
continuity_notes: The dead lamps foreshadow what the beacon will fix. The one burning lamp is the source of the spark she takes in SC05.

action: Gauge reads 84. She reaches the edge of the plaza. Beyond it, the street is black water.
character_position: at the quay edge, back to camera
prop_state: gauge: 84, steady
camera_intention: Over her shoulder into the flooded street. Hold on the water.
sound: Music cuts out entirely. Water lapping at stone.
continuity_notes: 84 is the handoff value into SC04. The street water level established here must match SC04_SH001.

action: Wide, low. The flooded lane. For a forty-centimetre machine this is a flood. She stops at the edge.
character_position: at the lane edge, frame right
prop_state: gauge: 84. Lamp-pole still carried.
camera_intention: Low wide with water filling the lower half of frame, so her scale against the water reads immediately.
sound: Water. Wind funnelling between buildings.
continuity_notes: Water level must match SC03_SH005. This is the same lane, seen from the other side.

action: She climbs a submerged market stall. Grip, haul, grip. Water sheets off her. Gauge 84 to 80.
character_position: on the stall, rising out of the water
prop_state: gauge: 84 to 80. Stall: submerged, used as a step.
camera_intention: Handheld feel at her height, tight. Slight instability to match the effort.
sound: Metal straining. Water sheeting off brass. The footfall ticks continue but are now irregular.
continuity_notes: First irregular tick. From here the rhythm degrades progressively and never fully recovers.

action: Railing traverse, hand over hand. Rain begins - sparse first drops on the water. Gauge 80 to 77.
character_position: along the railing, moving frame left
prop_state: gauge: 80 to 77. Railing: wet, slick.
camera_intention: Profile, the railing running as a hard horizontal line across frame with her above it.
sound: Rhythmic clicks. The first raindrops - distinct, countable.
continuity_notes: Rain starts here and never stops until SC09. First drops must be individually audible.

action: THE DROP. Her grip fails and she goes under. Bubbles. The gauge flickers, the needle stuttering. The surface becomes a bright ceiling above her.
character_position: underwater, below the railing
prop_state: gauge: 77 to 75, flickering. Lamp-pole: still gripped, nearly lost.
camera_intention: The camera goes under with her. Invert the reference: the surface is up and bright, the town is a dark ceiling of shapes.
sound: Everything muffles. A dull sub. Her clock motif distorted and slowing.
continuity_notes: The muffled sound world is used only here and in SH005. The needle flicker is the first sign the water has done real damage.

action: Underwater, looking up. Her shutter eyes glow amber in the murk. She plants her feet on the lane floor and pushes.
character_position: on the lane floor, pushing up
prop_state: gauge: 75, dimmed by water
camera_intention: Low, looking up at her rising. She should break frame at the top.
sound: Muffled. Then the first audible catch of her spring - a small bright note under the murk.
continuity_notes: The amber eye glow underwater is a signature image; keep the aperture half-closed so it reads as effort, not calm.

action: She breaks the surface and hauls herself onto a wall coping, sparking. Steam comes off her brass. Gauge 75 to 71.
character_position: on the coping, above the water line
prop_state: gauge: 75 to 71. Body: wet, sparking at the shoulder joint.
camera_intention: Low and tight, water streaming down the lens. Deliberately imperfect.
sound: The surface break, loud. Rain now steady and continuous.
continuity_notes: The shoulder joint sparks here and again in SC07_SH004. Same joint, so the damage is continuous, not incidental.

action: Wide. The gantry walkway spans the lane, rusted and swaying in the rising wind. She steps onto it.
character_position: at the gantry entrance, frame right
prop_state: gauge: 71. Lamp-pole: carried. Gantry: swaying.
camera_intention: Wide, the gantry running as a diagonal across frame with the tower visible at its far end.
sound: Wind up sharply. Iron creaking under load.
continuity_notes: The tower must be visible at the gantry's far end so the destination stays present during the obstacle.

action: Midway. A gust hits. She braces with the pole held horizontal. Gauge 71 to 68.
character_position: mid-gantry, low and wide
prop_state: gauge: 71 to 68. Pole: horizontal, used as a brace.
camera_intention: Low, wind from camera-right, rain now horizontal and streaking the lens.
sound: The gust as a solid wall of sound, not a whoosh.
continuity_notes: Wind direction is camera-right for the whole scene. The pole is horizontal here and leaves her hand in the next shot.

action: THE POLE GOES. A second gust takes the lamp-pole out of her grip. It spins away, strikes the water and is gone.
character_position: mid-gantry, reaching for nothing
prop_state: gauge: 68 to 66. Lamp-pole: LOST to the water. She is now empty-handed.
camera_intention: Follow the pole out of frame, then hold on the empty water where it went. Do not cut back to her immediately.
sound: The pole clattering on iron, one splash, then nothing. A hole opens in the sound.
continuity_notes: CRITICAL CONTINUITY: the pole is gone from here until SC07_SH005, where it is found wedged in the tower ironwork. It must not appear in SC05_SH004 through SC07_SH004.

action: She stands without it. Looks at her empty hand. Looks at the tower. Decides. The wind drops for one beat.
character_position: mid-gantry, still
prop_state: gauge: 66, unmoved. Hands: empty.
camera_intention: Close, static. Let the whole decision play without a cut - this is the scene's only stillness.
sound: The wind drops for exactly one beat. The only quiet in the storm.
continuity_notes: No gauge cost here. The stillness is the point; the audience must be allowed to register the loss.

action: She opens her chest drum. Inside: a live spark, taken from the last burning harbour lamp. She closes the glass against the rain.
character_position: mid-gantry, hunched over her own chest
prop_state: gauge: 66 to 64. THE SPARK: introduced, now inside her chest drum behind glass.
camera_intention: Macro. THE SIGNATURE IMAGE: an amber spark glowing inside the glass drum while rain streaks the glass outside it.
sound: The glass sealing. A small warm hum begins - the spark's own tone, which persists until SC08_SH003.
continuity_notes: The spark is now a permanent element of every shot until SC08. Its hum is the film's second leitmotif.

action: She moves on, one arm now curled across her chest to shield the glass. The spark is drawing power as she walks. Gauge 64 to 60.
character_position: along the gantry toward the tower
prop_state: gauge: 64 to 60. Spark: alive, draining her. Chest: shielded by her arm.
camera_intention: Tracking, with the spark glow the brightest element in frame and everything else falling away from it.
sound: The spark hum plus a new, slower tick layered over the footfall ticks - the drain is audible.
continuity_notes: From here she carries the pole-less silhouette: one arm across the chest. This posture is held until SC08.

action: Gauge insert: 60 to 58. Rack focus past the needle to the tower door ahead through the rain.
character_position: n/a
prop_state: gauge: 60 to 58. Tower door: visible ahead, shut.
camera_intention: Macro on the gauge, then a rack focus to the door. One move, no cut.
sound: Rain. The spark hum continues.
continuity_notes: The rack focus hands SC06 its first image. Door position and water level must match SC06_SH001.

action: The tower door: iron, swollen, barnacled. She stands at its foot. She is very small against it.
character_position: at the foot of the door, frame centre low
prop_state: gauge: 58. Door: shut, swollen.
camera_intention: Low wide, the door filling the frame above her. Compress her against the bottom edge.
sound: Rain on iron. The tower itself humming in the wind.
continuity_notes: Same door seen in the SC05_SH007 rack focus. Barnacle pattern and water line must match.

action: She levers it. Shoulder against the plate. It gives an inch. She resets and pushes again. It swings. Gauge falls fast: 58 to 49 to 40.
character_position: at the door, braced against it
prop_state: gauge: 58 to 40. Door: forced open. This is the single most expensive action in the film.
camera_intention: Tight on the effort, then a whip to the gauge as the needle drops. The whip is the only fast camera move in the film.
sound: Iron shrieking. Her spring straining - a sound not used anywhere else.
continuity_notes: Eighteen turns, the largest single cost. The needle must be seen crossing 49 on the way down so the arithmetic is legible.

action: Gauge insert. The needle crosses into the RED ARC of the dial. Hold.
character_position: n/a
prop_state: gauge: 40, needle inside the red arc for the first time
camera_intention: Macro, dead still. Identical framing to every other gauge insert.
sound: Everything drops out except the tiny friction of the needle. The quietest moment in the film.
continuity_notes: The red arc is introduced HERE and not at the climax, so the colour can do the worrying for us afterwards.

action: Interior. She steps in. A spiral stair rises into darkness, lit only by her own amber glow. Water runs down the inside of the wall.
character_state: relieved to be out of the wind, then apprehensive
character_position: entering, at the foot of the stair
prop_state: gauge: 40 to 35. Spark: still glowing in her chest, now the only light source.
camera_intention: She enters; the camera tilts up the stair, and keeps tilting, and keeps tilting. The tower's height in one continuous move.
sound: Her footsteps echo. Reverb opens up hard the moment she crosses the threshold.
continuity_notes: Her chest glow is the only light in the tower interior from here to SC08. The reverb change marks the interior/exterior boundary.
transition_out: Cut to the top of the stair.

action: The stair ends. A gap. Broken iron hanging. Beyond it, the wall - and through a breach, the storm outside. Gauge 35 to 31.
character_position: at the broken edge of the stair
prop_state: gauge: 35 to 31. Stair: collapsed, unusable. Breach: open to the exterior.
camera_intention: Her point of view across the gap first, then back to her. Two angles, no movement.
sound: Wind coming through the breach. The reverb narrows.
continuity_notes: The gap is why she must go outside. The breach framing here must match SC07_SH001 so the exit is legible.

action: She goes out through the breach onto the riveted plating. The gale hits her flat. She presses herself against the iron. Gauge 31 to 28.
character_position: on the exterior plating, flattened against the tower
prop_state: gauge: 31 to 28. No pole. Spark glowing through the rain.
camera_intention: Exterior wide. The tower as a vertical line, the sea white far below. She is a speck on it.
sound: The gale at full volume. Rain horizontal.
continuity_notes: First exterior since SC02_SH004. Plating and rivet pattern must match that establishing shot exactly.

action: The remaining section of stair tears away from the tower and falls. She watches it go. Gauge 28 to 25.
character_state: watching the last easy option leave
character_position: on the plating, looking down
prop_state: gauge: 28 to 25. Stair: gone entirely. There is now no way back down.
camera_intention: Follow the iron down and out of frame, then hold on empty air where it was.
sound: The crash, delayed and far below. Then wind.
continuity_notes: The stair is destroyed. No later shot may show intact stair. This is the point of no return.

action: The climb. Hand over hand on rivets. Rain. The horizon tilts as she gains height. Gauge 25 to 22.
character_position: ascending the plating, frame rising
prop_state: gauge: 25 to 22. Hands: on rivets.
camera_intention: A slow rising track matching her ascent. The horizon progressively tilts off-level so the height is felt rather than shown.
sound: Grab, strain, grab. Her gait rhythm now audibly irregular - the pattern established in SC04_SH002 continues to degrade.
continuity_notes: Longest single shot in the film at 8 seconds, placed at the point of maximum investment. The tilted horizon must be consistent through SH008.

action: GRIP LOSS. A gust peels her off the iron. She swings on one arm over the drop. Gauge 22 to 20.
character_position: hanging by one arm off the plating
prop_state: gauge: 22 to 20. Shoulder joint: the same one that sparked in SC04_SH006, now failing.
camera_intention: Reveal the drop with a long lens straight down to the water. Let the height land.
sound: One long metallic scream from the shoulder joint. Music out entirely.
continuity_notes: Same shoulder joint as SC04_SH006. The damage is cumulative and must be animated as a weakness, not a new injury.

action: Her free hand closes on something: the lamp-pole, wedged in the ironwork. It came up the tower with the storm.
character_position: hanging, one arm reaching
prop_state: gauge: 20, unmoved. Lamp-pole: RECOVERED, wedged in the ironwork.
camera_intention: Insert on the pole first, then her hand closing on it. Two frames of information, no exposition.
sound: A single bright note. The score returns, one instrument only.
continuity_notes: CRITICAL CONTINUITY: this is the pole lost in SC05_SH003. Its position wedged in the ironwork must be plausible - it was blown against the tower, not placed.

action: She uses the pole as a brace and hauls herself back onto the iron. Gauge 20 to 14.
character_position: back on the plating, braced on the pole
prop_state: gauge: 20 to 14. Lamp-pole: now a climbing brace.
camera_intention: Tight on the effort, with the gauge deliberately kept in the corner of frame so the cost is visible during the win.
sound: The strain. Her clock motif stuttering - now audibly skipping a note.
continuity_notes: The skipped note in the motif is the audio signature of a weakening spring and worsens through SH008.

action: The last stretch. Her limbs stutter. The gait breaks down entirely - she is dragging herself upward. Gauge 14 to 9.
character_position: high on the plating, dragging
prop_state: gauge: 14 to 9. Motion: degraded, no longer a rhythm.
camera_intention: Very tight, almost abstract: brass, rivets, rain. The world reduces to the next handhold.
sound: The mechanism audibly failing. Metal fatigue. The clock motif has stopped being a melody.
continuity_notes: The animation degradation is the storytelling here. Do not cover it with cutting - hold on the broken motion.

action: She reaches the gallery rail and pulls herself over, collapsing into the lee. Gauge 9 to 6. The burner chamber door is ahead.
character_position: over the rail, on the gallery floor
prop_state: gauge: 9 to 6, needle deep in the red arc. Lamp-pole: still in hand.
camera_intention: She collapses into frame and we hold. Let her be still for a beat before cutting.
sound: The gale drops sharply as she gets into the lee of the gallery.
continuity_notes: Six turns remain entering SC08. The red arc is fully engaged; it must read clearly even in this low, wet framing.

action: Interior, the burner chamber. Cold, enormous brass. Her glow is the only light in it. She is tiny.
character_position: on the chamber floor, at the foot of the burner
prop_state: gauge: 6. Spark: still glowing inside her chest.
camera_intention: Wide. She is very small in a very large space. Do not move the camera.
sound: The storm reduced to a murmur outside. Water dripping.
continuity_notes: Scale contrast is the whole point of this shot. Her glow must be the only light source in frame.

action: She climbs the last few rungs to the burner, opens her chest and lifts the spark out. Gauge 6 to 3.
character_position: at the burner, chest open
prop_state: gauge: 6 to 3. Spark: REMOVED from her chest, now held in her hand. Chest: empty and dark for the first time since SC05.
camera_intention: Close, following her hands. Unhurried.
sound: The spark's hum, now exposed and fragile without the glass around it.
continuity_notes: The chest goes dark here. Every shot from SC05_SH005 has had the glow; its absence is a deliberate visual loss.

action: She offers the spark to the burner. Nothing catches. She repositions and tries again. Nothing.
character_position: at the burner, reaching up
prop_state: gauge: 3. Spark: alive but finding nothing to light.
camera_intention: Tight on the spark and the cold brass. The gap between them is the subject of the shot.
sound: The hum, then silence. No catch. No click. Nothing.
continuity_notes: Two failed attempts, not one - the second is what tells the audience this is not a technique problem.

action: THE REVEAL. A static shot of the burner's heart: no wick, no oil, no flint. A socket. Cold brass. The exact diameter of a mainspring.
character_position: n/a
prop_state: THE SOCKET: revealed. Nothing else in the burner can accept the spark.
camera_intention: Locked off. No camera movement whatsoever. No music. The frame does not help the audience.
sound: Absolute silence. One water drop.
continuity_notes: The single most important shot in the film. The socket diameter must visibly match the coil in her chest - match it in design at T03.

action: On WICK. She looks at the socket. She looks at her own empty chest. A long beat - the whole decision, played without a cut.
character_position: at the burner, motionless
prop_state: gauge: 3. Chest: open and empty.
camera_intention: Close on her shutter eyes. The aperture closes, then opens. That is the entire performance.
sound: Her clock motif, stated once, complete, on a single instrument. The only complete statement in the film.
continuity_notes: The complete motif here is the payoff for the fragmented statements since SC01. Do not add strings under it.

action: She unspools her own mainspring and threads it into the socket. The gauge falls: 3, 2, 1. Then the ratchet engages.
character_position: at the socket, both hands working
prop_state: gauge: 3 to 1. Mainspring: REMOVED from her body, installed in the burner. Ignition costs the final turn: 1 to 0.
camera_intention: Macro, unhurried. This is not an action beat and must not be cut like one.
sound: The spring unspooling - a long, thin, singing sound. Then the ratchet engaging. Then her mechanism winding down to nothing.
continuity_notes: The spring is now part of the tower. She cannot be rewound by re-installing it; the ending's single turn is a new beginning, not a restoration.

action: Her shutter eyes go dark. A beat of black. Then - IGNITION. The beacon floods the frame until it is white-gold.
character_position: at the foot of the burner, silhouetted
prop_state: gauge: 0. Beacon: LIT. Spark: consumed.
camera_intention: Hold on her dark silhouette as the light blooms behind her. The frame goes to white-gold without a cut.
sound: One beat of absolute silence. Then the ignition: a huge, warm, low bloom. The score in full, for the first and only time.
continuity_notes: The only full-orchestration moment in the film. Her silhouette must stay readable inside the bloom.

action: Exterior. The beam sweeps out across black water. Rain turns to light inside the shaft.
character_position: n/a
prop_state: beacon: lit, rotating. Beam sweeping.
camera_intention: Locked wide. The deliberate long hold - the film's longest unbroken static shot.
sound: The beacon's slow rotation. The sea. Score sustained, no melody.
continuity_notes: The eight-second hold is protected. Do not cut into it for coverage. Beam rotation rate must match SH003.

action: Far out: the running light. It pauses. Then it turns - toward harbour. The reef line slides past behind it.
character_position: n/a
prop_state: ship: turned toward harbour, reef cleared. Reef line: same position as SC02_SH003.
camera_intention: Very long lens, the ship tiny in frame. Held. The turn must be small and easy to miss on first viewing.
sound: The bell buoy, now in rhythm with the beacon. The ship's two-note motif, resolved upward for the first time.
continuity_notes: Reef line and ship bearing must match SC02_SH003 so the audience can read that she turned away from danger.

action: Dawn comes up grey-gold over the water. The beacon dims as the dark goes. Then: the chamber, dark again, and WICK's silhouette at the foot of the burner.
character_state: present only as a silhouette at the end of the move
character_position: at the foot of the burner, motionless
prop_state: gauge: 0. Beacon: spent, dimming with the dawn.
camera_intention: Wide as the light dies, then a slow push toward her silhouette. One continuous move across the cut in mood.
sound: The beacon winding down. The score thinning to nothing. Dawn birds - the first living sound in the film.
continuity_notes: The beacon dims because the dark is gone, not because it failed. Birds are the only organic sound in the film and start here.
